001package com.streamconverter.path;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Arrays;
005import java.util.List;
006
007/**
008 * Represents a hierarchical path for tree-like data structures (JSON, XML).
009 *
010 * <p>This class handles parsing and matching of path expressions in both JSON-style ("$.user.name")
011 * and XML-style ("user/name") formats. It converts path expressions into hierarchical segments for
012 * efficient matching during data processing.
013 */
014@SuppressWarnings("PMD.TooManyMethods")
015// public API（fromXml/fromJson・matches/matchesIgnoringArraySyntax・equals/hashCode/toString）と
016// private パーサーヘルパー（parseJsonPathToSegments/parseComplexJsonPath/parseXmlPathToSegments 等）
017// が同居している。パーサーヘルパーは package-private クラスへ分離可能だが、TreePath 専用の
018// 実装詳細であり独立させる設計上の意義がないため現状を維持している。
019public class TreePath implements ITreeMatcher {
020
021  private final List<String> segments;
022  private final String originalPath;
023
024  // Private constructor for factory methods
025  private TreePath(String originalPath, List<String> segments) {
026    this.originalPath = originalPath;
027    this.segments = segments;
028  }
029
030  /**
031   * Creates a TreePath from an XML path expression.
032   *
033   * @param xmlPath the XML path expression (e.g., "user/name")
034   * @return TreePath instance
035   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xmlPath is null or invalid
036   */
037  public static TreePath fromXml(String xmlPath) {
038    if (xmlPath == null || xmlPath.isBlank()) {
039      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XML path cannot be null or empty");
040    }
041    String trimmedPath = xmlPath.trim();
042    List<String> segments = parseXmlPathToSegments(trimmedPath);
043    return new TreePath(trimmedPath, segments);
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Creates a TreePath from a JSON path expression.
048   *
049   * @param jsonPath the JSON path expression (e.g., "$.user.name")
050   * @return TreePath instance
051   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null or invalid
052   */
053  public static TreePath fromJson(String jsonPath) {
054    if (jsonPath == null || jsonPath.isBlank()) {
055      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON path cannot be null or empty");
056    }
057    String trimmedPath = jsonPath.trim();
058    List<String> segments = parseJsonPathToSegments(trimmedPath);
059    return new TreePath(trimmedPath, segments);
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Checks if current path matches the target path segments
064   *
065   * @param currentPath current path segments to match against
066   * @return true if paths match exactly
067   */
068  @Override
069  public boolean matches(List<String> currentPath) {
070    return segments.equals(currentPath);
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Checks if current path matches after stripping array-index syntax from this path's segments.
075   *
076   * <p>A segment like {@code "orders[*]"} or {@code "orders[0]"} is normalized to {@code "orders"}
077   * before comparison. This allows paths such as {@code "$.orders[*].product_code"} to match the
078   * streaming {@code currentPath} list {@code ["orders", "product_code"]}.
079   *
080   * @param currentPath current path segments built by the streaming traversal
081   * @return true if the normalized segments equal {@code currentPath}
082   */
083  public boolean matchesIgnoringArraySyntax(List<String> currentPath) {
084    if (currentPath == null) {
085      return false;
086    }
087    List<String> normalized = new ArrayList<>();
088    for (String segment : segments) {
089      // Strip leading $. prefix if present (handles complex path single-segment case)
090      String s = segment;
091      if (s.startsWith("$.")) {
092        s = s.substring(2);
093      } else if (s.startsWith("$")) {
094        s = s.substring(1);
095      }
096      // Split on dots to expand compound segments like "orders[*].product_code"
097      for (String part : s.split("\\.")) {
098        // Remove array index notation: [*], [0], [1], etc.
099        String stripped = part.replaceAll("\\[.*?\\]", "");
100        if (!stripped.isEmpty()) {
101          normalized.add(stripped);
102        }
103      }
104    }
105    return normalized.equals(currentPath);
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Returns the original path expression.
110   *
111   * @return the original path expression
112   */
113  @Override
114  public String toString() {
115    return originalPath;
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * 2つのTreePathが等しいかどうかをセグメントリストで比較する。
120   *
121   * <p>注意: 元のパス文字列（{@link #toString()} の値）が異なっていても、セグメントに展開した結果が同じであれば等しいとみなす。 例えば JSONスタイルの {@code
122   * "$.user.name"} と XMLスタイルの {@code "user/name"} がパース後に同じセグメントになる場合、 等しいと判定される。
123   *
124   * @param obj 比較対象のオブジェクト
125   * @return セグメントリストが等しい場合true
126   */
127  @Override
128  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
129    if (this == obj) {
130      return true;
131    }
132    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
133      return false;
134    }
135    TreePath treePath = (TreePath) obj;
136    return segments.equals(treePath.segments);
137  }
138
139  /**
140   * セグメントリストに基づくハッシュコードを返す。
141   *
142   * @return ハッシュコード
143   */
144  @Override
145  public int hashCode() {
146    return segments.hashCode();
147  }
148
149  // === Internal Implementation ===
150
151  private static List<String> parseJsonPathToSegments(String jsonPath) {
152    // Handle root path
153    if ("$".equals(jsonPath)) {
154      return new ArrayList<>();
155    }
156
157    // Handle array syntax preservation for JsonFilterCommand compatibility
158    if (jsonPath.contains("[")) {
159      // For complex paths with arrays, preserve original parsing logic
160      // This ensures JsonFilterCommand continues to work
161      return parseComplexJsonPath(jsonPath);
162    }
163
164    // Simple property paths: $.property or $.nested.property
165    if (jsonPath.startsWith("$.")) {
166      String pathWithoutRoot = jsonPath.substring(2);
167      if (pathWithoutRoot.isEmpty()) {
168        return new ArrayList<>();
169      }
170      return Arrays.asList(pathWithoutRoot.split("\\."));
171    }
172
173    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON path format: " + jsonPath);
174  }
175
176  private static List<String> parseComplexJsonPath(String jsonPath) {
177    // For paths with array syntax like $[*].name or $.users[0].name
178    // Keep them as single segments to maintain compatibility
179    // The actual array handling is done in JsonFilterCommand
180    return List.of(jsonPath);
181  }
182
183  private static List<String> parseXmlPathToSegments(String xmlPath) {
184    // Remove leading and trailing slashes without regex to avoid polynomial complexity
185    String normalizedPath = removeLeadingTrailingSlashes(xmlPath);
186    if (normalizedPath.isEmpty()) {
187      return new ArrayList<>();
188    }
189
190    // Split by single slash and filter empty segments to handle multiple consecutive slashes
191    List<String> segments = new ArrayList<>();
192    int start = 0;
193    for (int i = 0; i <= normalizedPath.length(); i++) {
194      if (i == normalizedPath.length() || normalizedPath.charAt(i) == '/') {
195        if (i > start) {
196          segments.add(normalizedPath.substring(start, i));
197        }
198        start = i + 1;
199      }
200    }
201
202    return segments;
203  }
204
205  /**
206   * Removes leading and trailing slashes from path without regex
207   *
208   * @param path the input path
209   * @return path with leading/trailing slashes removed
210   */
211  private static String removeLeadingTrailingSlashes(String path) {
212    if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) {
213      return "";
214    }
215
216    int start = 0;
217    int end = path.length();
218
219    // Remove leading slashes
220    while (start < end && path.charAt(start) == '/') {
221      start++;
222    }
223
224    // Remove trailing slashes
225    while (end > start && path.charAt(end - 1) == '/') {
226      end--;
227    }
228
229    return path.substring(start, end);
230  }
231}
